blocks.text: Let's solve this one step by step. Negative five times the quantity two x minus three y plus one.
Negative five multiplies all three terms, and each sign goes along.
Negative five times two x is negative ten x. Negative five times negative three y is positive fifteen y. And negative five times one is negative five.
So the answer is negative ten x plus fifteen y minus five.
Watch out for these traps. If you keep the middle term negative, you get negative ten x minus fifteen y minus five. If you multiply only the first term, you get negative ten x minus three y plus one.
